speech.heard: In Finland, 100% of the poorest adults have an account, in Yemen, only 6.5% do. In the USA, 95.6% of the poorest citizens hold an account, well above the global median. India has 86.3%, counting anyone who used a bank, shared account or mobile money service. China has 82.7%, while Brazil has 78.1%. At the bottom, Madagascar has 14.1%, Pakistan has 13.6%, and Yemen has 6.5%. Do the poorest adults in your country have bank accounts?
